_comment: DRAFT question set written by the team. Dataset A = resident-style questions with gold answers computed from the live API. Dataset B = regression questions built from bugs the stakeholder reported (refusal, out-of-scope, two-domain, masked block, specific category). REPLACE OR EXTEND dataset A with the stakeholder's 50 curated questions. Relative phrases resolve against FIXED_NOW = Fri 2026-11-13 12:00 Arizona time. gold.where is written by hand with explicit UTC TIMESTAMP literals (Arizona midnight = 07:00 UTC) so gold does not depend on the agent's own date code. CLOSURES NOTE: the traffic_control_restrictions layer is a stale snapshot (permits Jun 8 - Jul 11 2026), so C01-C10 pin the clock to Wed 2026-06-17 via the per-question 'now' field. C02 and C09 are expected to return nothing (true negatives). Offenses questions use FIXED_NOW (live data). REVISION: C01 and C08 were reworded after the pilot run (ambiguous 'closed'/'lane restrictions'); C11 and C12 added for the strict full-closure reading.
